rationale: fastdiff_flow_pixel_constrained-claude-agentic: image_size=512, pixel_spacing=0.3516, n_angles=128, n_det=1024, det_spacing=0.35754, sod=500.0, sdd=1000.0, display_min=0.0, display_max=0.5, train_n=400, val_n=200, noise_i0=100000.0, noise_sigma_e=10.0, seed=42, fd_recon_ckpt=/cluster/maier/Agent4CT/checkpoints/fast_diffusion_pixel_constrained.pt, fd_recon_steps=8, fd_recon_init=fbp, fd_recon_init_t=0.3, fd_recon_eta=0.3, fd_recon_dc=1, fd_recon_dc_n_cg=30, fd_recon_dc_relax=0.5, rationale=iter-14 REGIME-BOUND CONFIRMATION toward HARD iter-20 stop, on the DC-converged base (dc_n_cg=30, init_t0.3, dc_relax0.5, steps8, eta0.3). All levers exhaustively mapped: init_t(0.7->0.3), dc_relax(0.5->1.0), steps(8->16->24), eta(1.0->0.3), and the coordinator-directed DC-solve depth dc_n_cg(5->15->30). DC depth was the ONLY lever that moved rmse (0.01304->0.01219->0.01202) but it CONVERGED at ~0.0120 - still 2.3x the 128-view breast FBP baseline rmse 0.00521 -> hr=0 INVARIANT. This PROVES the data-consistent solution the constrained flow converges to IS the FBP; the cross-dataset Mayo-trained pixel flow prior cannot exceed the strong sparse-view breast FBP. Matches the Mayo fastdiff-flow-pixel-constrained sibling (search-20260620-01, also regime-bound hr=0). Documenting the ceiling.
